news.title: Proposed Trump arch design wins key agency approval
news.summary: The U.S. Commission of Fine Arts on Thursday approved a modified design of President Trump’s proposed 250-foot triumphal arch to be built at the entrance to Washington D.C., marking an integral step in the project’s process.
